summary: Frontend smoke and interaction testing completed across desktop and mobile. Core routing, console scanning/result, policy CRUD actions, audit modal, and settings controls work; event filtering and mobile overflow fail.

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal overflow at 390px viewport (document scrollWidth 746px vs clientWidth 390px), caused by the lower live-events panel/table escaping its table-wrap/container.

integration_issues.issue: Typing svc_support updates the displayed count to 1 but all 6 table rows remain rendered; filtered data is not passed to EventTable.

action_items: Pass filtered events into EventTable (or filter rows inside it) so search changes visible rows, not only the count.
Constrain dashboard lower-grid/panel width on mobile and preserve horizontal scrolling inside table-wrap without expanding the document.
critical_code_review_comments: Events computes filtered but renders <EventTable /> without a data prop, making search functionally misleading.
seed_data_creation: None; all data is frontend mock data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop routing, AI console, policies create/delete, audit modal, settings controls passed. Recheck event row filtering and 390px overflow after fixes.
rca of the issue: Live Events owns query/filter computation but EventTable closes over the global events constant and has no rows/data parameter. Mobile overflow comes from the dashboard lower-grid live-events panel retaining its 700px table minimum width outside the intended overflow wrapper. ALL DATA/API INTEGRATIONS ARE MOCKED; no backend API was exercised.
